title: 6.7 Asking for Help
unit_outcome: Name places in town and ways to travel, say where places are, give simple directions, say what you can and cannot do, ask for help, and read simple bus and train times.
goal: Ask for help politely with Excuse me. and Can you help me?, and understand Yes. or Sorry, no. and a short answer.
grammar_function: Excuse me. Can you help me? Yes. / Sorry, no. Where is the station? It is on the left.
prerequisite: 5.9 please and thank you; 3.4 yes; 4.3 Where is it?; 6.4 on the left; 6.6 can.
speaking_outcome: Ask a stranger for help and ask where a place is.
